formula_branch_definition: Sign of the literal decimal proposal projected into the one-dimensional orthogonal complement; certified using rational interval arithmetic.

H5_escape.candidate_feasibility_proof: Every candidate is negative at the strict H9 escape and nonpositive at the four fixed walls. Its pairing only decreases under the saved projection, since all projection coefficients are negative.

scope: Finite literal formula bank only. Conflicts are ignored and optional deletions only enlarge the intersection. Every exact norm-two formula branch in the bank has a common strict spacelike escape. This neither excludes other angle profiles nor all completions of the retained seed.
